name: seeya
description: Monorepo root for seeya (D-043): @seeya-ai/engine (core/application/adapters/scheduler), @seeya-ai/cli (the seeya binary). @seeya-ai/app is reserved, not created yet.

scripts.test: vitest run --project unit --project integration --project integration-process --project guards
scripts.cobertura: vitest run --project unit --project integration --project integration-process --project guards --coverage
scripts.verificar: npm run format:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run dependencias && npm run cobertura
